claim_boundary: This ladder ranks blockers for a future scalar EOM derivation. It is not a derivation and does not validate the scalar sector.

prerequisite_rows.failure_if_unresolved: dV_dPsi remains formal only; no mass scale, extrema, stability, or dynamics can be claimed.
prerequisite_rows.required_before_derivation: Specify potential form or explicitly retain generic symbolic calculus limits.

prerequisite_rows.failure_if_unresolved: Kinetic structure cannot be promoted to a definite EOM term and field dimensions remain open.
prerequisite_rows.required_before_derivation: Declare canonical value, sign, units, field dependence, and relation to Psi dimensions.

prerequisite_rows.failure_if_unresolved: Integration by parts cannot be used to claim a stationary action or Euler-Lagrange result.
prerequisite_rows.required_before_derivation: Declare boundary conditions or explicit boundary completion.

prerequisite_rows.failure_if_unresolved: Route remains a dependency map, not a calculation.
prerequisite_rows.required_before_derivation: State admissibility conditions and preserve all total-derivative terms until boundary closure.

prerequisite_rows.failure_if_unresolved: Dimensional/SI gate cannot close and physical interpretation remains blocked.
prerequisite_rows.required_before_derivation: Produce a unit ledger for S_Psi, Psi, V(Psi), Z_Psi, and dV_dPsi.

prerequisite_rows.failure_if_unresolved: T_Psi_mu_nu cannot be derived and conservation/divergence cannot be checked.
prerequisite_rows.required_before_derivation: Define metric dependence and variational prescription separately.

formal_placeholder_rules.dV_dPsi: allowed only as symbolic derivative of an unfixed potential
formal_placeholder_rules.Z_Psi: allowed only as held normalization placeholder
formal_placeholder_rules.delta_S_delta_Psi: allowed only as route label, not evaluated result
